verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents an Auth0 migration guide covering email/password with proper hashing, plus a script that migrates organizations, members and roles. A configurable password hashing function supports carrying over existing hashes. Users also note all auth data lives in their own database, which limits lock-in. missing for 10: a generic, source-agnostic bulk-import tool or API beyond the Auth0 guide, a documented export feature, and independent hands-on corroboration of hash-preserving import.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-import existing users — including password hashes — and export them again, so I am never locked in

citations.quote: we'll walk through the steps to migrate a project from Auth0 to Better Auth including email/password with proper hashing, social/external accounts, two-factor authentication, and more.
the script will also attempt a best-effort migration of Auth0 Organizations, their members, and per-member roles.
You can customize the password hashing function by setting the `password` option in the configuration.
You get all of your auth data in your own db in 1 cli command. You are not tied to any db provider.
